acceptanceCriteria: Factory default roles are computed once per analysis and reused
A test asserts identical results before and after the cache
A benchmark or recorded measurement on a synthetic large suite shows the per-fixture cost no longer scales with file count
body: Residual of V1-1770 (PR #1121, GitHub #1115), which delivered the ACTOR-UNAUTHORIZED analysis in internal/testsource/actor_auth*.go for Rails + CanCanCan with Playwright request.<verb>(literal path). Expected: factory default roles are indexed once per analysis. Actual: factoryDefaultRole rescans all source files on each call, so cost is O(fixtures x files) on large Rails suites.
title: Actor-authorization factoryDefaultRole rescans every source file per fixture (O(files) per call)
